name: money-amount
title: Money amount
description: An amount of money with currency, sign and meaning in words, for credits, debits and refunds, in tabular figures.
docs: amount is an integer in minor units (1250 is 12.50; JPY has none); a fraction is rounded to the nearest minor unit. direction credit, debit, refund or auto (the sign of the amount) decides the sign, the weight and the sr-only word. A currency code Intl rejects is written as digits and the code. Meaning never depends on red and green.
